description: Defines the SharedBuffer class for inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore-based synchronization, including constructors, methods for locking/unlocking, and accessors for administration data.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared memory buffer with semaphore synchronization for inter-process communication.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A nested class managing semaphore locking mechanisms, platform-dependent.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for consumer role, initializing shared buffer with given name.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for producer role, setting up shared buffer with specified mode, size, and administration area.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests lock for producing data, waits up to specified time.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete and unlocks consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests lock for consuming data, realigns buffer based on administration data.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed and unlocks producer semaphore.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns number of bytes written to buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Sets user permissions based on username.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Sets group permissions based on group name.
